claims.text: Step 2: Open the Instant Form Editor either from the Tools tab (choose Instant Page, click Create, then select the Instant Form tab) or during campaign creation (create a Lead Generation campaign, select Instant Form as the Optimization Location at the ad group level, then click + Create in the Destination section at the ad level).

Track form completion rate: the mechanism is an in-app form opened from the ad CTA or Form Card, so the share of users who open the form and submit it is the direct performance measure; the trade-off is that required consent steps and more questions may lower completion while raising lead quality.

relationships.name: Lead ads
relationships.difference: Pinterest Lead ads let people fill in a form within the ad without leaving Pinterest, delivering their information to the advertiser; TikTok Instant Form is the equivalent native in-app lead capture for TikTok Lead Generation ads, opened via the ad CTA or a Form Card on the in-feed video.
relationships.context: Both are native, in-platform lead capture forms for paid social lead generation; the difference is the platform and the specific engagement surfaces (TikTok CTA/Form Card vs Pinterest in-ad form).
